A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CAD-Editor work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original quantitative comparisons, human evaluation, ablations, and qualitative CAD-editing results in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and adds complexity-scaling and Fusion 360 Gallery evaluation results in Appendix E.

M1.justification: Sections 3–5 retain the same synthesis pipeline, LCS masking, locate-then-infill procedure, LLM backbone, and selective-data fine-tuning. Newly documented filtering rules in Appendix A do not establish a revision to the existing method.

E1.justification: Appendix E adds evaluation on Fusion 360 Gallery and a separate DeepCAD experiment covering four- and five-operation structures beyond the original three-operation coverage. The original training restriction is retained in Appendix A, rather than removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding main comparisons and ablations retain the same methods. New scaling and transfer experiments use the existing GPT-4o-Basic and GPT-4o-IC comparators. CAD Translator is newly cited but is not evaluated.

E3.justification: V2 adds Chamfer Distance to the main and ablation evaluations. Appendix E introduces balanced training with 4,000 examples per operation count, totaling 20,000, separate tests by count, and direct DeepCAD-to-Fusion transfer. The original main split, training settings, and human-evaluation protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix E adds analyses of performance across CAD complexity and transfer to a different shape distribution. Figure 7 adds demonstrations involving explicit numerical and relative parameter instructions. The original captioning, locate-then-infill, and human-selection ablations are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions state that Table 1 averages three runs. V2 introduces no additional run-count disclosures, seed information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 add Chamfer Distance results, and Tables 4–5 add scaling and transfer outcomes. In table units, CAD-Editor's main D-CLIP changes from 0.27 to 0.11; Table 2's Direct and L-I values change from -0.16 to -0.19 and 0.21 to 0.03. Main JSD, validity, and human-evaluation scores remain unchanged. The PDFs do not explain the numerical revisions.

T1.justification: The probabilistic decomposition, autoregressive formulas, LCS construction, and D-CLIP definition are unchanged. Neither version supplies theoretical propositions or proofs; the added Chamfer Distance evaluation introduces no new mathematical development.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central claims: introducing text-based CAD editing, automated triplet synthesis, a locate-then-infill framework, and superior empirical performance. Explicitly mentioning LLMs in the contribution list restates their existing role.

C2.justification: V2 discusses Chamfer Distance's limited ability to measure semantic consistency, explains the data-imbalance rationale, and interprets the new experiments as supporting complexity scaling and cross-dataset generalization. It also extends the human-selection interpretation to generation quality. Section 7's stated limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 adds a code-repository link and documents filtering thresholds: excluding pairs with more than three editing instructions, more than five mask tokens, or no-change instructions. Appendix A also supplies dataset-distribution statistics. Most hardware, hyperparameter, and prompt information was already present in v1.

R1.justification: V2 adds CAD Translator and distinguishes transformer-based CAD generation from LLM-based approaches. Additional references cover prompting, fine-tuning, CLIP, and Fusion 360. These extend the background without redefining the work's central novelty or research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized wording edits, separates metrics into Section 6.2, reorganizes the appendices, corrects the prompt-table cross-reference, and updates publication and author information. Most of the main narrative and method exposition is retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds parametric and extended-scenario panels in Figures 7 and 15 and two new result tables. Tables 1–2 gain CD columns and reordered metrics; teaser examples change, and prompt figures are enlarged and reformatted. Earlier qualitative comparisons are retained and relocated, rather than newly introduced.

improvement.justification: V2 better supports the unchanged method through complexity and cross-dataset tests, an additional geometric metric, and clearer preprocessing and code-access information. The gains are limited by incomplete specification of the new test sets and an overbroad superiority statement in Appendix E: Table 4 gives GPT-4o-IC a better two-operation D-CLIP score than CAD-Editor (-0.06 versus -0.23). Overall, the revision improves empirical support and transparency without resolving all evaluation weaknesses.
